name: witness
description: Proof-of-work mode. Every completion claim carries evidence: reproduce the failure, fix the code under test, show the same unmodified check passing. Catches the six ways a green check lies.

interface.longDescription: Reproduce the failure before fixing it, change the code under test rather than the check, and prove the fix with the same unmodified check. Flags softened assertions, suppression comments, skip markers, swallowed errors, no-op fixes and fixture fitting.
defaultPrompt: Use witness mode for this task.
Reproduce this bug before you fix it.
Show me the evidence that this is fixed.
